q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Net sales and orders both fell about half week‑on‑week: net sales dropped from ₹6,42,531 (2026-10-05..10-11) to ₹3,08,218 (2026-10-12..10-16), −52.0%; orders fell 339 → 161, −52.5%. Ad spend also fell sharply (₹4,30,736 → ₹1,97,621, −54.1%), while reported net ROAS rose (0.825 → 0.989) and net profit moved from −₹75,331 to −₹2,228 (order‑date basis).

What changed (largest impacts first)
- Ad spend and volume moved together: paid media spend halved (−54.1%) and sessions dropped in the same window; the orders decline matches the fall in ad-driven volume, so lower investment and less traffic are the biggest concurrent changes.  
- Campaign / ad-level dropouts: several campaigns/ads went to zero (examples flagged: TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+, campaign id 120250695088250783; and ad TH-383‑SUSPENDER‑4XL‑MAROON_BN520_TM099), and one creative’s conversion mix shifted (TH-222-WINGBIRD showed a conversion-rate change / share shift). These drops explain where volume disappeared.  
- Efficiency improved per order: ROAS and net AOV were modestly higher, and net profit per rupee of spend improved, so the remaining spend was more efficient even as total sales fell.

Confidence and limits
- The drop itself is clear in the data; the diagnosis did not single out a lone causal mechanism — ad spend, sessions and add‑to‑cart events moved together and campaign-level shutdowns are strong candidate contributors. Today's data (2026-10-16) is partial.

Worth checking: confirm whether budgets/pauses were applied to the named campaigns and why those ads fell to zero (budget, status change, or delivery issue).
